scenes.headline: How Sentry shows an agent its lessons only when failing
scenes.sub: Failure memory kept outside the prompt, retrieved on a detected failure.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Lassi! Agents that remember past mistakes can trip over those memories. Here's how Sentry avoids that.

scenes.text: Keep failure lessons outside the agent's context, and show only the few that match a failure while that failure is happening.
scenes.say: The idea: a failure lesson is conditional. Keep it outside the agent, and show it only while that failure is happening.

scenes.title: Two ways failure knowledge goes wrong

steps.say: Memory like ACE keeps rules from an old failed search in context. Later the agent finds the right item and never buys it.
A fixed monitor's no-progress warning rescues one task, then fires after valid option clicks, and the agent loses them.

scenes.title: When the agent sees a lesson

left.title: Always-on memory
items: In the prompt at every step
left.say: Context memory picks its lessons at task start and keeps them in the prompt at every step.

right.title: Sentry
items: Shown only on a detected failure
At most five, matching the label
right.say: Sentry keeps them outside, and shows a few only on a detected failure.

steps.say: Sentry runs beside the agent. Each step, a detector reads the last five steps and asks whether something is going wrong.
An invalid action goes to hard repair: the agent rewrites it.
A loop, a stall or a hallucination goes to soft repair, which pulls at most five lessons matching the diagnosed label.
Only now does the agent see recovery advice. While it progresses, it sees none.
Ten steps later a verifier, blind to the reward, checks that the failure stopped. Only a repair that worked becomes a lesson.

scenes.title: Same lessons, different exposure
scenes.note: held-out WebShop reward, same frozen playbook
scenes.say: Same playbook. Also putting every lesson in the prompt drops WebShop reward from point three six four to point two nine six.

scenes.title: Task memory and failure memory compose
scenes.say: And the two kinds of memory stack: task advice up front, failure advice on a trigger.

scenes.text: Storing failure knowledge is the easy part. Deciding when the agent sees it matters just as much.
scenes.say: Storing failure knowledge is easy. Deciding when the agent sees it matters just as much.

recap: Retrieved only on a matching failure
Saved only if the repair worked
scenes.say: Lessons out of the prompt, retrieved on a matching failure, saved only when the repair worked.
